about: Machine-readable work queues for the six workstreams. GitHub Issues hold each story; this file says which story each workstream is on, what comes next and what blocks it. The orchestrator thread updates it at the weekly review and when a lead reports a story done. Check and render with: python docs/product/operations/tools/queues.py all

rules.needs_chris: New user-facing features need a mockup and Chris's typed go; Fabric capacity or cloud spend needs his typed yes. Such stories are blocked, never ready, until he answers.

WR-101.title: Every Delta metadata append retries a first-write race the way run writes do
WR-101.problem: Run writes retry a concurrent first commit ('Protocol changed' / 'Metadata changed'); a few metadata appends still fail on it.
acceptance: Each remaining metadata append goes through the after-commit retry with a bounded backoff
A concurrent first-writer test covers each one and shows no row loss

WR-102.title: The start-up, notebook-start and SQL benchmark flags a regression against a stored baseline
WR-102.problem: The Windows benchmark job (#1874) is advisory and nobody compares runs.
acceptance: A stored baseline per runner image
Two runs in a row more than the agreed margin slower mark the job failed and name the step
Baseline updates are a reviewed file change

WR-103.title: Out-of-memory and full-disk during a local run stop cleanly and say why
WR-103.problem: A large local run that hits memory or disk limits should leave tables unchanged and give one plain message.
acceptance: Tests force a memory limit and a full temp folder during a write
No partial commit; the message names the limit and the setting to change

WR-201.title: Every Fabric and OneLake call honours 429 Retry-After and long-running-operation limits through retrying.py
WR-201.problem: Some Fabric paths still use hand-written retry loops (carry-over of #1667); throttling must never turn into a failed run or a hammering client.
acceptance: An inventory test lists each Fabric REST call site and fails on a hand-written retry loop
429 and 503 with Retry-After are waited out within a cap
Long-running operations poll with a deadline and say when it passed

WR-202.title: Fabric errors shown to a user carry the request id and one next step
WR-202.problem: Support needs the Fabric request id; users need to know what to do.
acceptance: Every Fabric error surface includes the request id when Fabric sent one
A test checks each mapped error code has a next step

WR-203.title: Warehouse T-SQL refused list and docs stay in step after this week's merges
WR-203.problem: #1869 ties docs to code; new functions landed since.
acceptance: Docs check green on main
